items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Filed For EU Crohn's Disease Label Expansion
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) has submitted a regulatory application to the European Medicines Agency for SKYRIZI (risankizumab) subcutaneous induction in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's disease. The filing seeks to add a less invasive induction treatment option to AbbVie's Crohn's disease portfolio in Europe.
